requirements.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:44,51,58 use `\\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection` / `\\App\Enums\TicketStatus` (double leading backslash), which is a PHP parse error, so the serve page cannot load. The Members page tabs (activeTab, setActiveTab, tablist, members_tab_* keys) are missing from the diff entirely. Queues::mount (Queues.php:32) and Serve::mount (Serve.php:27) do not authorize. rename passes a null slug (Queues.php:91) instead of re-deriving it. The detail modal toggles directly (queues.blade.php:55), and confirmToggle is never reachable from the UI. There is no render() providing accessQueue/accessGrants: `$accessQueue()` at queues.blade.php:112 is an undefined variable. callNext has no rate limit. A foreign selectedQueueId makes the waiting list throw 404 instead of showing serve_empty (Serve.php:56), and call permission is not checked there.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes do go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket. However, there is no #[Validate] on name/renameName/mode/selectedQueueId. Strings are hard-coded instead of using lang keys: 'Active'/'Inactive' (queues.blade.php:35), 'Select Queue', 'Mode' and the mode options (serve.blade.php:12,23-27), even though matching keys were added. The Blade views start with a stray `<?php // ... ?>`. Grant/revoke buttons reuse the unrelated members_remove/members_save labels. Docs and CHANGELOG are not updated.

security.evidence: Neither component authorizes on mount (Queues.php:32 has no `authorize('create', Queue)`, Serve.php:27 has no `authorize('view', $entity)`), so the employee 403 is missing. The actions rely on the domain actions authorizing internally and resolve ids scoped (`$this->entity->queues()->findOrFail`, `memberships()->findOrFail`), which is good. lastCalledTicketId is not #[Locked] (Serve.php:24). `mode` is not validated, so `CallMode::from` raises a ValueError/500 on a tampered value (Serve.php:57,85). Helpers accessQueue/hasAccessGrant are public endpoints (Queues.php:142,150). There is no rate limiting on callNext. Output is escaped with {{ }}.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files at all. There are no feature, unauthorized-call or tamper tests, although conventions.md requires them for every Livewire action.

simplicity.evidence: The structure is direct. Problems: duplicate `'queues_activate'` key in both lang files (lang/en/ui.php:111 and :115). hasAccessGrant runs one QueueAccess query per membership from the view (Queues.php:156 via queues.blade.php:124). The confirm modal calls `$entity->queues->find($viewingQueueId)` repeatedly (queues.blade.php:97,100). The Serve component has both a getFirstCallableQueueId loop and a getCallableQueuesProperty filter that do the same filtering.

readability.evidence: Unused imports: Gate in Queues.php:12, and User/Queue/TicketStatus in Serve.php. routes/web.php:58-59 use fully-qualified class names despite the new `use` imports. The navbar link indentation is inconsistent (default-page.blade.php:48). The confirm modal's button is always labelled 'deactivate'. There are filler comments like `// nothing extra` and the stray PHP comment blocks in the views.

scope.evidence: Everything in the diff relates to the task (two components, views, routes, nav, lang). There are only minor extra lang keys (serve_title, ticket_* labels), which serve the views.

issues.explanation: Return types `\\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection` (also line 51) and `\\App\Enums\TicketStatus` (line 58) are PHP parse errors, so the Serve component cannot load.
The Members page tabs (activeTab, setActiveTab, tablist markup, members_tab_members/invites keys) are not implemented at all.
No tests ship with the change, which violates the mandatory TDD and Livewire test policy (happy path, validation, unauthorized and tamper tests).
mount does not authorize `create` on Queue, so employees can open the queue management page instead of getting a 403.
mount does not authorize `view` on the entity.
`$accessQueue()` is not a view variable (there is no render() passing accessQueue/accessGrants), so opening the access modal errors and the accessQueue/accessGrants view-data contract is missing.
rename passes a null slug to UpdateQueue instead of re-deriving it from the new name, so renaming 'Old' to 'New' keeps slug 'old'.
Deactivate/reactivate calls toggleActive directly from the detail modal, and confirmToggle is never triggered, so the required confirmation modal is bypassed.
callNext has no RateLimiter, although the task requires rate-limiting successful calls per user and entity.
The waiting list uses findOrFail and no `call` check, so a foreign or missing selectedQueueId throws 404 instead of showing serve_empty, and a user without call permission can see a queue's tickets.
lastCalledTicketId is not #[Locked], and `mode` is not validated, so tampering yields a ValueError/500 from CallMode::from.
The access list does not show managers as calling without a grant.
There is no #[Validate] on name/renameName, contrary to the Livewire validation convention.
The helpers accessQueue/hasAccessGrant are public methods and therefore callable endpoints; they should be protected/computed.
Hard-coded English strings ('Select Queue', 'Mode', mode options, and 'Active'/'Inactive' in queues.blade.php:35) instead of lang keys; the call button and selects lack aria-label/associated labels.
Docs and CHANGELOG are not updated for the new pages.
The routes use fully-qualified class names while the imports added above go unused; Gate is also imported but unused in Queues.php.

review.summary: The change adds Queues and Serve Livewire components, views, routes, nav links and lang keys, but the Serve component has PHP parse errors and the Members tabs are missing entirely. Neither component authorizes on mount, rename does not re-derive the slug, the toggle confirmation is bypassed, the access modal references an undefined view variable, callNext is not rate-limited, and no tests are included. It needs substantial rework, so I would reject it.
